home.metaDescription: Rugged mobile computers, RFID handhelds and industrial tablets for warehouse, manufacturing, retail and field service. Solution design, configuration and OEM / ODM cooperation.

hero.body: Powering smarter operations with rugged mobile computers, RFID technology and intelligent data capture solutions — engineered for the real world.

why.body: We select and configure devices around the task: the capture method, the form factor, the software and the support path after rollout.

pillars.title: Rugged by design
pillars.body: Devices chosen for warehouse, field and industrial environments. Protection and operating limits are confirmed per SKU.

pillars.title: Integrated auto-ID
pillars.body: Barcode, UHF RFID, NFC and document capture configured around the workflow, not added afterwards.

pillars.title: Configuration flexibility
pillars.body: Android and Windows platforms, multiple form factors and module options for regional requirements.

pillars.title: OEM / ODM ready
pillars.body: Private label, configured products and project development under your brand and your documentation.

portfolio.body: Explore rugged PDA computers, RFID handhelds and rugged tablets for enterprise data capture.

solutions.body: Each industry page maps common tasks to capture methods, device configurations and a deployment path.

entries.title: Warehouse & Logistics
entries.body: Receiving, put-away, cycle counting, picking and dispatch — captured before inventory reaches the WMS.

entries.title: Manufacturing
entries.body: Work orders, WIP, material traceability and maintenance rounds captured at the point of work.

entries.title: Retail & Commerce
entries.body: Replenishment, price accuracy, RFID stocktakes and labeling at the point of decision.

entries.title: Field Service & Assets
entries.body: Inspections, digital work orders, asset audits and on-site documentation for mobile teams.

process.body: The same four gates apply whether you are evaluating a single device or planning a fleet deployment.

steps.title: Workflow review
steps.body: Map the steps, exceptions and data each step must produce before selecting hardware.

steps.title: Configuration
steps.body: Choose form factor, capture modules, OS, accessories and integration points.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.body: Deploy to one site or shift and compare accuracy, cycle time and exception rates.

steps.title: Rollout & support
steps.body: Stage devices, configure MDM, train users, plan spares and agree the support path.

oem.body: From logo customization to tailored hardware configurations, TRAKNOVA supports partners developing and scaling their own industrial mobility portfolio.

faq.body: If your question is not here, include it in the form. We will answer it against your workflow and target market.

items.a: Sample and pilot policy is agreed per project. For configured products, a prototype or pilot build is the usual acceptance step before a production order.

items.q: Can devices be branded for our company?
items.a: Yes. Private label and configured-product cooperation are covered on the OEM / ODM page, including logo, packaging, documentation and software image options.

items.q: Do you support regional RFID frequencies?
items.a: UHF RFID bands and market approvals differ by country. We confirm the target market before selecting the module and include the applicable configuration in the proposal.

items.q: How do I get a datasheet?
items.a: Send an inquiry with the model and configuration you are evaluating. We will confirm the applicable datasheet, options and availability for your market.

cta.body: Tell us what you need. Our team will help identify the right device and configuration.
